title: RentGuard Renters Policy Conditions — Cancellation for Nonpayment of Premium
content:
## Condition

**1. Notice.** A notice of cancellation for nonpayment of a RentGuard Renters Policy is issued only when an installment has remained unpaid past the nonpayment notice period that starts on the installment due date. The period is counted in calendar days from the due date recorded on the installment's billing entry, using the tier's nonpayment notice period; the notice may be issued from the day after the due date plus that period.

**2. Scheduled cancellation date.** The scheduled cancellation date is the notice date plus the tier's notice-to-cancellation period in calendar days. When a landlord is listed as interested party, it is never earlier than the notice date plus the tier's interested-party notice period, and the notice is copied to the interested party. While the notice stands the policy is pending cancellation.

**3. Rescission.** The notice is rescinded only when payments received after the notice date and before the scheduled cancellation date total at least the amount due as of the notice date. The amount due as of a date is the sum of the installments billed with a due date on or before it, plus the fees charged, payments returned, additional premium and refunds posted on or before it, less the payments received, fees waived, return premium and write-offs posted on or before it, and never below 0.00. Rescission returns the policy to in force.

**4. Cancellation.** When the scheduled cancellation date arrives without that cure, the policy is cancelled that day for nonpayment, and the unearned premium is credited pro rata, with no retention and no minimum earned premium.

All of these judgements rest on the policy's premium account and policy record — the installment's due date, the notice date and scheduled cancellation date, and the payments posted — not on the customer's recollection.

## Timeline (hypothetical dates; notice period 12 days, notice-to-cancellation period 10 days)

| Date | Event |
|---|---|
| 1 March | Installment due |
| 13 March | Last day of the notice period; no notice may yet be issued |
| 14 March | Earliest day a notice may be issued |
| 14 March | Notice issued; scheduled cancellation date 24 March |
| 15 to 23 March | Payments in this span count toward rescission |
| 24 March | Without the cure, the policy is cancelled for nonpayment |

## Points of judgement

- A payment received on the notice date itself is not received after the notice date and does not count toward rescission; nor does a payment received on the scheduled cancellation date.
- If the amount due on 14 March was 41.20 and payments of 20.00 on 16 March and 21.20 on 22 March were received, they total 41.20, at least the amount due, and the notice is rescinded. With 21.19 on 22 March instead, the total of 41.19 falls short and the policy is cancelled on 24 March.
- Where the landlord listed as interested party is owed the same 10 days' notice, the scheduled cancellation date remains the notice date plus 10 days.
